questions.question: 1) What is the primary function of a VR headset?

answers.b: Track user movements and display immersive 3D environments
answers.d: Act as a standalone gaming console

explanations.a: Incorrect – VR headsets display 3D environments, not just 2D images.
explanations.b: Correct – A VR headset tracks user movements and displays immersive 3D environments.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Projecting holograms is a function of AR or MR, not VR.
explanations.d: Incorrect – While some VR headsets can run standalone applications, they are not full gaming consoles.

questions.question: 2) What does a game engine do in VR development?

answers.b: Integrates physics, animations, lighting, and interactivity
answers.d: Controls the user's physical movement in real life

explanations.a: Incorrect – 3D modelling software creates 3D assets, not the game engine.
explanations.b: Correct – Game engines like Unity integrate physics, animations, lighting, and interactivity.
explanations.c: Incorrect – A game engine is a software platform, not hardware.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Game engines control interactions within a virtual world, not physical movement in real life.

questions.question: 3) Which of the following is a key advantage of using XR technologies in VR development?

answers.a: Allows users to experience interactive digital environments
answers.b: Limits user movement to predefined paths
answers.c: Reduces the need for hardware in VR applications
answers.d: Replaces all physical interactions with virtual ones

explanations.a: Correct – XR technologies enable users to engage in interactive and immersive digital experiences.
explanations.b: Incorrect – VR applications allow free movement based on tracking, not fixed paths.
explanations.c: Incorrect – VR still requires hardware like headsets and controllers.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Some VR systems integrate physical elements instead of replacing them.

questions.question: 4) What is the role of lighting in a virtual reality scene?

answers.b: Improves immersion by simulating realistic environments
answers.d: Has no effect on user experience

explanations.a: Incorrect – Lighting is used for more than just aesthetics; it also affects realism and visibility.
explanations.b: Correct – Proper lighting enhances immersion by making environments feel more realistic.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Lighting does not affect model size, only visibility and mood.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Lighting plays a major role in VR experiences.

questions.question: 5) What is the purpose of controllers in a VR system?

answers.a: They display 3D visuals to the user
answers.b: They track user hand movements and enable interaction with the virtual environment
answers.d: They replace the VR headset in providing an immersive experience

explanations.a: Incorrect – VR headsets display visuals, not controllers.
explanations.b: Correct – Controllers allow users to interact with and manipulate objects in VR.
explanations.c: Incorrect – The game engine handles rendering, not controllers.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Controllers work alongside the headset, not as a replacement.
